title: crypto2dev_status: adding _reserved[24] is silent ABI break for CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS ioctl number
description:
include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h, struct crypto2dev_status:

    struct crypto2dev_status {
        __u32 fips_state;
        __u32 num_algorithms;
        char  version[32];
        __u8  _reserved[24]; /* reserved; must be zero */
    };

Adding _reserved[24] changed sizeof(struct crypto2dev_status) from 40 to 64 bytes.

CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS is defined as:
    _IOR(CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_MAGIC, 9, struct crypto2dev_status)

The _IOR/_IOW/_IOWR macros encode sizeof() in bits [29:16] of the ioctl command number.
Old ioctl number encoded size 40; new number encodes size 64.

These are different ioctl command numbers. The kernel ioctl dispatcher matches the
full command number. Any binary compiled against the old header will send the old
command number; the kernel (compiled against the new header) will not recognize it
and return -ENOTTY.

Severity: silent breakage for any out-of-tree code or pre-compiled binaries
that include this header. No warning is emitted — the old ioctl simply fails.

The 'correct' way to extend an ioctl struct without breaking ABI is either:
  (a) Don't add fields — define version-checking conventions and document exact
      struct size in the header comment so binaries detect mismatches.
  (b) Use _IOC_NONE + manual size passing, accepting the loss of size checking.
  (c) Assign a new ioctl number for the extended struct.

At this stage (pre-release), changing the struct size is acceptable IF the
version number is bumped (it was changed to '1.1.0' in ioctl_status()) AND
IF the ioctl number change is explicitly documented as a deliberate ABI
version break in the header.

The current _reserved[24] addition has NO accompanying ABI version comment
explaining that CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS now encodes size 64 instead of 40.

Action required: either revert _reserved[24], or add a prominent comment
documenting the ioctl number change and the compatibility break.

Files: include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h (struct crypto2dev_status, line 350)
       src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c (ioctl_status, line 1492 — version string '1.1.0')
